reason: Observed arena70 startup exceeded 10% PSI while MemAvailable stayed >45 GiB, active swap-in/out was negligible (vmstat samples <=59 kB/s), and the server completed fault-in/pinning in 82.7 s; PSI fell to 1.9% afterward. A PSI-only stop falsely labels transient pinning stalls as memory exhaustion.

revised_stop_guard.psi_alone: record and communicate; do not stop if MemAvailable >=32 GiB, swap-in/out remains below threshold, and system responds
